page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable review guidance. A skill is text and configuration — never code — and any agent can use it.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: A skill is reusable review guidance — a rubric, a convention, a security rule. Write one, or import a markdown file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

create.title: Create a skill
create.subtitle: Name it and say when it applies — you'll write the body next.
create.starterBody:
# {name}

Describe the rule the reviewer should apply, and when it applies.

config.title: Configuration
config.bodyHint: Markdown. This text is appended to the prompt of every agent you attach it to — saving a change bumps the version and snapshots the old text.
config.versionMessageHint: What changed in this version? Shown in the Versions tab; leave it blank and a summary is derived from the diff.

evals.title: Evals arrive with their own lesson
evals.body: Scoring a skill against saved cases needs the eval module. Until then, compare a review run with the skill on and off — the run trace shows the exact prompt block it added.

stats.promptCostNote: Approximate — added to every review by every agent that uses it.
stats.untracked: Not tracked yet — findings are not attributed back to the skill that produced them.
stats.noAgents: No agent uses this skill yet. Attach it from an agent's Skills tab.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every save snapshots the body, so a past run can still be read against the exact text it used.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore the body from v{version}? This is saved forward as a new version; nothing is erased.
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history.

drawer.title: Import a skill
drawer.subtitle: Upload a markdown file or an archive — you'll see exactly what gets stored before anything is saved
drawer.trustNotice: An imported skill's text becomes instructions inside your agent's prompt. Read it before you enable it. Only markdown is imported: nothing from the file is executed, and nothing is written to disk.
drawer.fileHint: A .md file, or a .zip whose markdown is taken as the skill. Max 512 KB.

import.ignoredHint: These archive members were listed but never opened, stored or run.
import.bodyPreview: What will be stored — parsed from {filename}

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: This text is appended to the prompt of every agent you attach it to.
file.success: Imported "{name}". It stays off until you enable it.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side and left disabled until you have read it.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

listItem.vettingTitle: Someone else wrote this — read it before enabling

preview.renderedAs: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.previewSubtitle: This body is appended to the prompt of every agent that uses it
preview.editSubtitle: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version
preview.thirdPartyNotice: This skill was imported. Its text is sent to the model as instructions, exactly like a skill you wrote yourself — read it before enabling it for an agent.
preview.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? It is removed from every agent that uses it.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag .then() chains and ask for async/await
fields.descriptionHint: The skill's interface — write it as a directive, saying when the skill applies. This is what an agent reads first.
